newsitem.title: CHINA: China says new oil field found in South China Sea.
newsitem.headline: China says new oil field found in South China Sea.

text.p: The China Offshore Oil Nan Hai East Corp (CONHE) and operators Agip (Overseas) Ltd of Italy, Chevron Overseas Petroleum Ltd and Texaco Petroleum Maatschappij (Nederland) BV said they had discovered a new oil field in the eastern district of the South China Sea, the China Daily said on Thursday.
The field, 172 km southeast of Hong Kong, is the fifth discovered by CONHE and the ACT OG consortium in the Pearl River mouth basin, the newspaper said.
It did not give the size of the find but said the field indicated rich reserves and would be jointly developed after a detailed appraisal in 1997.
The ACT OG consortium groups units of Agip SpA, Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc.
The newspaper gave no more details.
